newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India declines all SKO, HSD term offers.
newsitem.headline: India declines all SKO, HSD term offers.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has declined all offers for its one-year term tender to purchase superior kerosene and high speed diesel, industry sources said on Monday.
"We received a telex from IOC saying they regret that they cannot accept our offer which was the lowest for the kerosene and 0.5 and 1.0 percent diesel tender," one source said.
Industry sources said IOC did the same thing last year when it cancelled the first term tender and subsequently re-issued another tender before awarding contracts for the April/March fiscal year.
Traders say IOC usually issues an initial tender to get a feel for the market, adding that they expect the company to re-issue a similar tender shortly as was the case last year.
Bother tenders closed on March 13 and offers were valid until March 17.
